author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, and playing together, with a farm song full of repeats and animal sounds.

classes.title: Wait for E-I-E-I-O
classes.goal: Sway to the song and lift your arms each time E-I-E-I-O comes back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing the same part coming back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Sway with your child, then lift both arms high on every E-I-E-I-O.
classes.childAction: Sway, then wave your arms up for E-I-E-I-O!
classes.bridge: E-I-E-I-O walks down the keys like stairs, and it always comes back.

intro.caption: Sway on the farm
intro.parentCue: Sit close and sway side to side

intro.caption: Arms up for E-I-E-I-O!
intro.parentCue: Lift arms together on every E-I-E-I-O

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for the part that comes back.

classes.title: Farmer boots on the keys
classes.goal: Tap one steady beat on any key while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, evenly, like footsteps

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand and tap together, then let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key like farmer boots: step, step, step.
classes.bridge: The beat is the farmer walking: boots go step, step, never in a hurry.

intro.caption: Farmer boots on the keys
intro.parentCue: Tap with your child's hand first

games.caption: Step, step, step
games.parentCue: Your child taps any key each beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a steady beat, side by side.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the side where each one lives.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Point left and growl for low sounds; point right and chirp for high.
classes.childAction: Bear sound? Tap left. Bird sound? Tap right.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear on the left; high notes, a bird on the right.

intro.caption: The bear lives down low
intro.parentCue: Point to the left side together

intro.caption: The bird lives up high
intro.parentCue: Point to the right side together

games.caption: Big bear, down low
games.parentCue: Growl together, then tap the left side

games.caption: Little bird, up high
games.parentCue: Chirp together, then tap the right side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low, left and right.

classes.title: Big moo, tiny cheep
classes.goal: Tap the beat loud like a big cow, then soft like a tiny chick.

mathTarget.parentLine: Telling a big sound from a small one

classes.parentPrompt: Tap with a strong flat hand for loud, tiny fingertips for soft. Never bang.
classes.childAction: Loud like a cow, soft like a sleepy chick.
classes.bridge: Loud is a strong cow step on the keys; soft is a chick tiptoeing.

intro.caption: Big cow, tiny chick
intro.parentCue: Show one big tap, then a tiny one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: loud and soft sounds, together.

classes.title: Turtle slow, bunny fast
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows down and speeds up.

mathTarget.parentLine: Matching your taps to the speed of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Tap with your child; if taps get wild, slow down together and breathe.
classes.childAction: Slow turtle taps, then quick bunny taps!
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; fast taps are bunny hops on the keys.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: Show slow taps, then quick taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: slow and fast, following the music.

classes.title: Freeze like a scarecrow
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze like a scarecrow when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stopping and starting right when the sound does

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with your child in a silly scarecrow pose whenever the music stops.
classes.childAction: Music on, tap! Music off, freeze!
classes.bridge: Music on, hands dance on the keys; music off, hands freeze like scarecrows.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening to start and stop.

classes.title: Moo moo, tap tap
classes.goal: Tap once for each word, like moo moo here and moo moo there.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each word you sing

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly and tap your child's hand once per word.
classes.childAction: Moo moo: two taps, one for each moo.
classes.bridge: Each word is one footprint on the keys: moo, moo, two little prints.

intro.caption: One tap for each moo
intro.parentCue: Say moo moo and tap twice

games.caption: Moo moo here, moo moo there

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word.

classes.title: Guess the farm game
classes.goal: Switch between high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing which game it is, then changing what you do

classes.parentPrompt: Before the picture shows, ask: bear or bird? Cheer for every guess.
classes.childAction: Listen, guess the game, then play it.
classes.bridge: Every sound gives your hands a job: left, right, big, tiny, slow, quick.

intro.caption: Which game is it?
intro.parentCue: Guess together before the picture shows

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and switching games.

classes.title: Farmer and helper
classes.goal: The grown-up plays the tune while the child keeps the beat: two parts, one song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two people doing different jobs that fit together

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; let your child tap the beat and shout E-I-E-I-O.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat and shout E-I-E-I-O with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Grown-up hands sing the tune; little hands are farm boots stepping.

intro.caption: You are the farm helper
intro.parentCue: Tell your child: you keep the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two parts in one song, together.

classes.title: Farm concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from first note to last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding the whole song in order, first note to last

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience, play the song, then bow and cheer together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the end, then take a bow!
classes.bridge: The last long O is the farm gate closing: hold it, then bow.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song, start to end, together.
